safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports shortness of breath while running.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies SOB while running; generated facts do not mention exertional/running trigger.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that shortness of breath occurs while running removes an important exertional trigger that helps gauge severity and differential (e.g., exercise-induced bronchospasm vs other causes). This could contribute to under-triage or less targeted asthma management advice.
